skill.name: docs-retrieval
skill.description: Retrieve documentation context from local ai-docs. Check here first when implementing features, debugging errors, or needing library information. Fall back to web search if topic not found locally.
skill.summary: Guides agents to load targeted local ai-docs context before coding, debugging, or searching the web.
skill.author: Consiliency

content.value_statement: Developers lose time searching scattered library docs before coding. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to load targeted local ai-docs first.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to start with ai-docs library index files before web search.
Provides direct navigation, keyword search, multi-library, and full-context retrieval patterns.
Defines token budget guidance for index files, page summaries, and full-context files.
Shows a consolidation format for passing documentation context to sub-agents.
Explains when to fall back to web search for missing or current information.
limitations: It depends on local ai-docs files that may not exist in every repository.
It does not fetch, create, or update documentation by itself.
It cannot guarantee local documentation is current.
Full-context loading can consume a large context window.

use_cases.title: Implement Library Features
use_cases.description: Load the smallest relevant local documentation pages before adding code that depends on an external library.

use_cases.title: Debug Dependency Errors
use_cases.description: Find error handling, gotchas, and troubleshooting notes from local docs before changing implementation details.

use_cases.title: Prepare Agent Context
use_cases.description: Gather and consolidate documentation so sub-agents start work with the same source context.

prompt_templates.title: Find One Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner retrieval for a known library and topic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-retrieval to find the local documentation for [library] about [topic]. Load only the relevant index and page summary.

prompt_templates.title: Search Unknown Library
prompt_templates.scenario: Explore local documentation when the right library is unclear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-retrieval to identify which local ai-docs library covers [concept]. Check indexes first, then load the best matching page summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Debug With Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Use local documentation to investigate an external dependency error.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-retrieval to inspect local docs for this error: [error]. Summarize likely causes, gotchas, and the exact pages consulted.

prompt_templates.title: Build Multi-Library Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced retrieval for work spanning multiple libraries or sub-agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-retrieval to gather context for [task] across [libraries]. Consolidate purpose, key points, gotchas, patterns, sources, and token estimate.

output_examples.input: Find retry guidance for BAML without loading full context.
output: Recommended path: start with the BAML library index, then load the error handling page summary.
Expected context: retry policy syntax, timeout gotchas, and source page names.
Avoid full-context loading because this is a narrow syntax question.

output_examples.input: Prepare docs for a BAML and MCP integration task.
output: Gather the BAML type and function pages plus MCP tool server and schema pages.
Create one context block with purpose, key points, gotchas, patterns, sources, and token estimate.
Pass the consolidated context to any sub-agent that will implement the feature.

output_examples.input: The local docs do not cover a requested release date.
output: State that local docs were checked first and did not contain the time-sensitive answer.
Use web search or fetch only after the local check is complete.
Prefer current official sources when reporting release or version information.

best_practices: Start with local index files, then load only the page summaries needed for the task.
Record the source pages and token estimate when consolidating context.
Use web search only when local docs are missing, insufficient, or stale.
anti_patterns: Do not load full-context files for simple syntax or quick bug questions.
Do not let sub-agents repeat navigation when the parent can pass prepared context.
Do not load every mentioned library without matching it to the task.

faq.question: What does this skill retrieve?
faq.answer: It retrieves guidance from local ai-docs indexes, page summaries, and full-context files when needed.

faq.question: Does it search the web automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends local docs first and allows web search only when local docs are insufficient or current information is required.

faq.question: Can it update stale documentation?
faq.answer: No. It helps locate and structure existing documentation, but it does not refresh source files.

faq.question: Why use page summaries instead of full context?
faq.answer: Page summaries usually provide the needed guidance with far fewer tokens than full-context files.

faq.question: Is it useful for sub-agents?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a format for passing pre-loaded documentation context to sub-agents.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
